edits.old: Queue membership and queue measures are read through `GET /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/cases` and the capacity and membership interfaces; the case-list operations are contracted in RWB-P3-E1020-CON.
edits.new:
Queue measures are read through `GET /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/cases`; the case-list operations are contracted in RWB-P3-E1020-CON. No membership operation is published on the P3 contract: QueueMembershipQuery is internal to rwb-case and reads `queue_member` in `rwb_case` (GAP-1176). The queue, its team code, its role code and its table version are read from P3; the role, its rights and its scope are read from P4 (GAP-1176).

The rollback operation (`POST /api/recovery/case/v1/admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/rollback`) and the verify operation (`/api/recovery/case/v1/admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/verify`) are owned by P3 in the ownership map but are not provided by this story. They are published in a later rwb-case contract story; until then AC2 and AC7 are tested against the contract fake (GAP-0682; ASM-1229).

edits.new: `rwb_case` keeps TEAM as reference data and keeps only `role_code` as a code on the queue, validated at load time over the authorise contract (DP-08). The role table is loaded by P4 (rwb-access); this story loads no role row and keeps teams, queues and reference rows in P3 (GAP-3159).
